# PLAN — iteration 2
## Current state assessment
Iteration 1 is the verified best so far: LUTs fell from 394 to 161 and setup WNS improved from -10.25 ns to -9.368 ns, with hold slack at 0.108 ns. Timing is still infeasible. The advisor trial’s critical path crossed six DSP48E1 levels from a product register to the stage-2 accumulator, so another change limited to history pairing is unlikely to address that bottleneck.

## Hypothesis
Distributing the eight constant products across existing elastic stages will shorten the longest arithmetic path and may improve setup WNS while preserving the five-slot latency, at the cost of extra partial-sum and operand registers.

## Instruction for generator
Keep the top interface, `// @latency 5`, history update, and ready/valid logic unchanged. Replace the stage-2 all-eight-product accumulation with two four-product groups: register the first group’s partial sum and the remaining pair operands in stage 2, compute and register the second group’s partial sum in stage 3, combine both partial sums in stage 4, then round and saturate into the existing stage-5 output register. Carry each payload only when its destination slot is ready and its source slot is valid; preserve signed widths, exact arithmetic, reset behavior, and output stability under stalls.
